title: Coverage map
text:
Two views of the same coverage data are available from the layer control at the top right. Provinces and territories (default): click a jurisdiction to see the models recorded for it. Ecozones: click an ecozone to see the models recorded for a province or territory it overlaps. A filled area has at least one model; the fill does not show an exact model footprint or imply a recommendation. The largely unforested Arctic ecozones (Arctic Cordillera, Northern Arctic and Southern Arctic) are not shown. Where a model applies only to part of a jurisdiction, the region is noted in the popup. Coverage is summarized here and may be out of date; confirm details on each model’s website.







Boundary data: Simplemaps, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Ecozones: National Ecological Framework for Canada (AAFC), Open Government Licence – Canada.

title: Canadian Forest Growth & Yield Model Registry
text:
Explore Canadian forest growth and yield models
A registry of forest growth and yield models developed for or applicable to Canadian forests. Entries are brief pointers to each model’s website, downloads, and publications; consult those sources for current details.
Browse the filterable model catalogue, or use the coverage map to explore recorded coverage by province or territory.
This registry is a starting point, not the authoritative source. Models evolve (new species, new coverage areas, new versions) and this registry is updated only periodically. Use the links on each entry to the model’s website and repository for current details. A province-level filter can include a model used in only part of that province, or in an adjoining US state; read each coverage entry’s region before using a model for a location. Missing information is shown as “Not recorded”, not inferred from other fields or links.
The map is jurisdiction-level only, and a downloadable query database is not yet available. A filled province or territory is not a model footprint, a calibration or validation statement, or a recommendation.

title: Models
text:
Filter this catalogue by model type, management context, province or territory, availability, output type, whether it has tools to help run it, or a species keyword. This registry is a starting point, not the authoritative source: models change over time and entries here are updated only periodically, so use the model website and repository links to confirm current details. The species search matches text, not a standardized species taxonomy; species lists are general summaries, so no match does not prove a model excludes a species. Jurisdiction matches refer only to recorded coverage, which can be limited to a region, ecosystem, or US state noted for that jurisdiction; read each coverage entry before interpreting a match as geographic applicability. When an entry covers multiple model versions, a filter match may describe only one version; check the model notes and link titles before applying it to another version.

    National stand-volume models of Ung et al. (2009), Nat1 and Nat2
    
      Model ID: 
      NationalModelUng2009
    
    Model information
    
      Model details
      
        
          Developers: 
          C.-H. Ung; P.Y. Bernier; X.J. Guo; M.-C. Lambert
        
        
          Contributors: 
          Not recorded
        
        
          Organization: 
          Canadian Forest Service, NRCan
        
        
          Model type: 
          whole_stand
        
        
          Programming language: 
          R
        
        
          Availability: 
          public download
        
        
          Interface: 
          r package
        
        
          Output types: 
          merchantable volume;basal area
        
        
          Species: 
          25 Canadian tree species
        
        
          Minimum inputs: 
          stand age; degree-days above 0 C (dd0); mean annual precipitation (map, mm); species
        
        
          Silvicultural interventions: 
          Not recorded
        
        
          Other features: 
          Not recorded
        
        
          Management context: 
          unknown
        
        
          Notes: 
          R implementation of the two national stand-volume models of Ung et al. (2009). Predicts gross merchantable volume (m3/ha) from age and climate; Nat1 also predicts dominant height and basal area. The paper intended the models for short (<10 year) projections. Parameters are published to only 4 decimals. Climate is descriptive, not for future scenarios. Nat1 has an optional bias correction that is not part of the published model. The package is experimental and MIT-licensed.

          2026-10-26
